title: Vintage Book My Son My Son by Howard Spring 1938 Hardcover
descriptionText:
This vintage hardcover book titled "My Son My Son" by Howard Spring was published by Grosset & Dunlap in 1938. It is a classic piece of literature that will make a great addition to any collection. The book is written in English and covers topics related to literature and fiction. 

The book's binding is hardcover, and it was printed in the United States. The author, Howard Spring, is well-known for his contributions to classic literature. This book will surely be a valuable addition to any antiquarian or collectible book collection.
